description: Call prep sheets for Kate Bugakova and Wendy's/Cognition both included an 'Action Items' checklist section and a blank 'Notes' section. These are post-call artifacts and do not belong in prep sheets. Prior prep sheets (SST Innovation Lab, Issac Hicks) do not include these sections.
correction: Call prep sheets end after the talking points or a light 'After the Call' pointer section if there are specific follow-up hooks. No action item checkboxes, no blank notes fields.
systemic_fix: Reference existing call-prep files (e.g., 2026-05-18-sst-innovation-lab-call-prep.md) before generating new ones. Do not add sections not present in canonical examples.
